title: Retrieve and rerank with Sentence Transformers
snippet: A retrieval pipeline first finds candidate passages. A cross encoder then scores query passage pairs to improve relevance. Dense embeddings and lexical search can provide different candidate sets.

title: Sentence-BERT sentence embeddings
snippet: Sentence BERT uses siamese and triplet networks to produce sentence embeddings. Cosine similarity between vectors supports semantic retrieval and clustering without scoring every text pair jointly.

title: Reciprocal rank fusion for information retrieval
snippet: Reciprocal rank fusion combines ranked result lists using reciprocal rank positions. It avoids assuming that scores from lexical retrieval and semantic retrieval have a common numerical scale.

title: Hybrid retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion
snippet: Combine lexical BM25 search and vector similarity rankings. Rank fusion provides a starting point for hybrid retrieval when relevance scores from separate retrievers are difficult to normalize.

title: Maximal marginal relevance and diversity
snippet: MMR balances query relevance with novelty against results already selected. Diversity reranking can reduce duplicate recommendations and redundant passages in information retrieval.

title: MiniLM sentence embedding model
snippet: This compact English sentence transformer maps short paragraphs to 384 dimensional vectors. It can support semantic similarity and retrieval. Long inputs need explicit truncation or chunking.

title: Chrome activeTab permissions
snippet: Chrome extensions can request temporary access to the current page following a user action. The activeTab permission and scripting API support narrow page extraction without persistent access to every site.

title: Manifest V3 extension service workers
snippet: Extension service workers are event driven and may stop between events. Persistent state belongs in storage rather than global variables. Extension code must be packaged rather than loaded remotely.

title: WebExtensions browser extension development
snippet: Build browser extensions with manifests, isolated scripts, permissions and extension pages. Understand cross origin requests and browser APIs when developing a toolbar popup.

title: Chrome extension examples
snippet: Official sample browser extensions demonstrate scripting, storage, toolbar actions and manifest permissions. Use small examples to understand browser extension behavior.

title: Chrome extension user data handling
snippet: An extension must explain how it handles user data, including website content processed locally or transmitted to servers. Permission minimization and privacy disclosures matter for browser publishing.

title: Build Python APIs with FastAPI
snippet: FastAPI provides typed Python HTTP routes, request validation and generated OpenAPI contracts. Pydantic models validate incoming payloads and document endpoint schemas.

title: Pydantic model validation
snippet: Validate Python API data using structured models, constraints and field validators. Reject unknown fields and check string sizes before application processing.

title: ASGI middleware with Starlette
snippet: ASGI middleware can bound request bodies, apply trusted host rules and attach response headers. Middleware order changes error handling and cross origin behavior for Python APIs.

title: Deploy ASGI applications with Uvicorn
snippet: Run a Python ASGI server behind a trusted reverse proxy. Configure worker processes, graceful shutdown, concurrency and network bindings for API deployment.

title: HTTPX timeouts for HTTP clients
snippet: Python HTTP clients need connection, read, write and pool timeouts. A bounded connection pool and total request deadline protect an API when an upstream service is slow.

title: Apache Kafka producer and consumer concepts
snippet: Kafka stores event streams in partitioned logs. Consumer groups assign partitions to workers. Producers and consumers must handle delivery semantics, offsets and duplicate processing.

title: Kafka delivery semantics and transactions
snippet: At least once event delivery can cause duplicates. Idempotent producers and transactions solve specific Kafka boundaries; downstream database effects still need idempotency keys.

title: Idempotent consumer pattern
snippet: A message handler records processed event identifiers or uses unique constraints. Retrying delivery must not apply business side effects twice. This supports reliable event processing.

title: Make retries safe with idempotent APIs
snippet: Use caller supplied request identifiers to make repeated API requests safe. Define the difference between retrying an operation and intentionally requesting a new operation.

title: PostgreSQL unique constraints
snippet: Database unique constraints and primary keys enforce data integrity. They can prevent duplicate records from repeated ingestion or concurrent retries of an event processing workflow.

title: Redis key expiration and caching
snippet: Redis keys can expire after a TTL. Bounded caches improve request latency but require careful cache keys, expiry and isolation when data belongs to different users.

title: Fallback behavior in distributed systems
snippet: Fallback paths can increase load or return unexpected behavior during failures. Design bounded dependencies and understand how a failure changes the response contract.

title: Circuit breaker architecture pattern
snippet: A circuit breaker temporarily stops calls to a failing remote service. Open and half open states bound repeated failures and allow controlled recovery in distributed applications.

title: Handling overload in reliable services
snippet: Reject work before resources are exhausted. Concurrency limits and load shedding help services preserve useful capacity instead of accepting an unbounded queue of requests.

title: Service metrics and instrumentation
snippet: Counters and histograms describe service requests, errors and latency. Avoid high cardinality labels such as individual user identifiers or raw URLs in monitoring systems.

title: Observability with metrics traces and logs
snippet: Observability connects logs, metrics and traces to explain service behavior. Exclude sensitive request content from spans and use bounded attributes for operational analysis.

title: Server side request forgery
snippet: SSRF happens when a server fetches attacker controlled addresses. Private networks, redirects and DNS resolution complicate allowlisting. Avoid arbitrary URL fetches when a fixed upstream API is sufficient.

title: Prevent DOM based cross site scripting
snippet: Untrusted search results should be rendered as text rather than inserted as HTML. Validate navigation protocols and avoid executable strings or unsafe DOM sinks in browser extensions.

title: Validate JWT access tokens with PyJWT
snippet: Verify JWT signatures using an explicitly allowed algorithm and trusted keys. Check issuer, audience, expiration and required claims rather than trusting decoded token content.

title: OAuth proof key for code exchange
snippet: PKCE binds an OAuth authorization code to a verifier held by a public client. Browser applications and extensions cannot keep a client secret confidential.

title: OAuth security best current practice
snippet: OAuth deployments need current security controls for redirect URIs, authorization codes and token exposure. Public clients must not rely on a distributed static client secret.

title: TextRank for extraction and summarization
snippet: TextRank applies graph based ranking to text. Sentence graphs can select summary sentences and word graphs can identify keywords without generating new claims.

title: Text feature extraction and TF IDF
snippet: Bag of words and TF IDF transform documents into sparse feature vectors. Lexical baselines are cheap and interpretable but cannot reliably match paraphrases with no shared terms.

title: Introduction to Information Retrieval
snippet: Information retrieval covers tokenization, inverted indexes, relevance ranking and evaluation. BM25 and term weighting provide useful lexical search baselines.

title: Cross encoder relevance reranking
snippet: A cross encoder jointly processes a query and candidate text. It is useful for reranking a small retrieved set, with greater inference cost than comparing independent embeddings.

title: Container build practices
snippet: Use small trusted base images, dependency locks and a non root user. Containers should have explicit resource limits and should not embed application secrets in image layers.

title: Kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaling
snippet: Horizontal pod autoscaling changes replica count using resource or custom metrics. Capacity limits, startup time and upstream provider quotas constrain useful service scaling.

title: GitHub Actions continuous integration workflows
snippet: A CI workflow checks code changes with automated tests, linting and security scans. Least privilege permissions and reviewed dependencies limit workflow risk.

title: Reproducible Python projects with uv
snippet: A project lock file resolves direct and transitive Python dependencies. Frozen synchronization helps a CI job install a reviewed dependency graph consistently.

title: Python unittest testing framework
snippet: Unit and integration tests verify API contracts, failure handling and security boundaries. Deterministic fixtures support reliable regression checks without live network dependencies.

title: Pytest fixtures and test isolation
snippet: Reusable fixtures establish isolated test state and dependency replacements. Mock upstream services to test timeouts, malformed responses and rate limits without real provider credentials.

title: TREC information retrieval evaluation
snippet: Retrieval evaluation uses topics, document collections and relevance judgments. Measure ranking quality on held out queries rather than assuming attractive example results imply general accuracy.

title: Workload measurement and capacity planning
snippet: Measured workload characteristics guide resource planning. Peak request rate, service time and concurrency matter more than calling an untested system enterprise scale.
